title: Require Service Database Topology
forbids: an open service database interior; database ownership under a module or embedded API service; or generated, memory, repository, session, persistence, helper, index, provider, and alternate source shapes
why: A database is an optional service-owned persistence boundary. Closing it to migrations, schema, and stores keeps persistence authority at the service root without creating a module, provider, resource, or project.
remediate: Keep an optional standalone database at services/<service>/src/service/db with only migrations/*.sql, schema/*.schema.ts, and stores/*.store.ts. Move external acquisition to a resource/provider and project store capabilities through named service-root middleware.
message: Service databases must retain one closed migrations, schema, and stores boundary.
